aiResearchSummary.text: Labelbox is engaged in research and development of systems and methods for automated content annotation workflows. The disclosed approach involves registering multiple labelers, populating a labeling queue with content data, and assigning annotation tasks from the queue. This work focuses on streamlining the process of annotating data, which is central to building intelligent applications. The area of research and development centers on efficient content annotation management.
